page_key.description: Stable key from scripts/generate-page-inventory.mjs. Unique. Never hand edited.

section_key.description: Section slug, e.g. leads, operations, lead-distribution

section_label.description: Human label of the section, e.g. Lead Distribution

title.description: Page title as shown in the Application Review tree

route.description: Route path, including any ?tab= for tab surfaces

parent_route.description: Set on tab surfaces, points at the page that hosts the tab

tab.description: Query string tab value when route_type is tab

portal_scope.description: Audience. Portal surfaces carry isolation requirements.

route_type.description: Kind of surface. Redirects and catchalls are inventoried but carry no readiness weight.

component.description: React element name mounted by the router

component_path.description: Repo path of the page component

layouts.description: JSON array of the layout chain wrapping this route

auth.description: Whether the route sits inside ProtectedRoute

nav_visibility.description: hidden means reachable but absent from the operator sidebar

permission_key.description: Permission key from src/lib/permissions.js that gates this route

roles.description: JSON array of role presets that can reach this surface

entity_dependencies.description: JSON array of Base44 entities read by this page, derived from the import graph

function_dependencies.description: JSON array of backend functions invoked by this page

component_dependencies.description: JSON array of source files in this page's transitive import graph

criticality.description: Human judgement. Drives readiness weight: critical 5, high 3, normal 1, low 0.5

readiness_weight.description: Explicit override of the weight implied by criticality

lifecycle_status.description: The six state model. implemented_unverified is NOT verified, and a developer saying done cannot set verified.

verification_status.description: Derived from VerificationRecord evidence, never set by hand in the UI

dimension_scores.description: JSON object of the seven readiness dimensions, each 0 to 100. Missing dimensions score 0.

readiness_score.description: Computed 0 to 100. Written only by progressReadiness. Explainable from dimension_scores and lifecycle.

readiness_explanation.description: JSON breakdown showing how readiness_score was reached, so the number is never a black box

migration_required.description: Whether this surface must work before LeadByte can be switched off

leadbyte_equivalent.description: The LeadByte screen or capability this replaces, blank when there is none

known_risks.description: JSON array of risk strings carried over from human metadata

purpose.description: What the page is intended to do and who uses it

strengths.description: What it currently does well. Evidence backed.

human_notes.description: Nick's notes. Never overwritten by any sync.

needs_human_review.description: Set when a conclusion depends on business knowledge only Nick has

last_code_change.description: Most recent change to this page or a file in its dependency graph

last_audit_run_id.description: Most recent AuditRun that produced findings against this surface

review_stale.description: True when code changed after the last review. Not set for unrelated commits.

inventory_synced_at.description: Last time the generated fields were refreshed from the manifest
